Thus the component containing vertex n need not be a tree, so its asserted 2-colouring and the ensuing signed-sum bound are unjustified. No independent all-n lower-bound proof appears elsewhere. A local replacement can fix this: since the component edge counts sum to fewer than the vertex counts, some connected component has |E_T|<|V_T|; connectedness then forces that component to be a tree.
